model_annotation: This image displays three distinct pie charts, each illustrating the proportional distribution of different linguistic or logical categories. The second chart, labeled “Approximate Number Generation,” contains three segments: “Approximate Quantities” (45.03%, beige), “Comparative Relationships” (36.26%, light blue), and “Absolute Absence” (18.71%, light purple), with “Approximate Quantities” forming the largest portion. The third chart, “Disjunctive & Conjunctive,” is split nearly evenly into two halves: “Disjunctive” (49.51%, light lavender) and “Conjunctive” (50.49%, light pink), with “Conjunctive” slightly larger. Each slice is clearly labeled with its category name and precise percentage, and the charts use distinct pastel colors to differentiate categories visually.
